title: A Three-Day Safari: What Fits In
excerpt: Only three days? A short safari can still be amazing. What fits in, and when flying makes sense.
body:
## By road: Tarangire and Ngorongoro

- Day 1: Arusha to Tarangire, game drive.
- Day 2: to Karatu, optional Lake Manyara.
- Day 3: Ngorongoro Crater, back to Arusha.

## By air: Serengeti

Fly from Arusha to the Serengeti, spend two nights and fly back. More expensive, but you see the Serengeti.

## From Zanzibar

Fly from Zanzibar to [Nyerere](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/) or to the Serengeti for two or three nights.

## After Kilimanjaro

A three-day safari is a perfect add-on. See [Kilimanjaro and safari](/blog/kilimanjaro-and-safari-combined/).

## Expectations

You will see a lot, but it is busy. Five days or more gives more room.

[Plan your short safari](/travel-proposal/).
